summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 report bug fixes (Points 3/4/5) via Playwright on the public preview URL, logged in as superadmin@fundle.io at /crm/login. ALL THREE features verified working. (1) Store KPI (/admin/reports/store-kpi): skpi-recon now renders THREE lines; first line is 'Overall Sales New ₹63,870.33 + Repeat ₹23,460.35 + Unmapped ₹12,500.00 + Returns -₹5,457.63 = ₹94,373.05' with a green CheckCircle (emerald svg present, no amber warning) — identity ties exactly. 'Unmapped Value' option exists in skpi-cols picker; enabling it added the 'Unmapped Value' money column to the table (row0 K00055 => ₹12,000.00). (2) CRM Customer Report (/admin/reports/crm-customers): 'Home Store' select (crm-store) present with 67 options, first 'All stores'; 'Home Store' column visible by default showing 'K00055 · City Centre Mall, Guwahati' style values; selecting a store + Apply sent store_id to /api/kpi-reports/crm-customers and /crm-summary (both 200) and narrowed results (e.g. 1 of 1 for KAJENTERP, 3 of 3 for K00055) with all rows sharing the selected home store; KPI cards + charts recompute for the filtered store. (3) Shopper Bill Report (/admin/reports/shopper-bills): no 'sbr-th-second_last_visit' header, no '2nd Last Visit' text anywhere, and no such option in the column picker; 'Cust Type' shows derived New / New Repeat / Existing (and '—' for unmapped/walk-in bills); with range 2020-01-01→2026-08-26, cust-type='new' auto-refetched 46 rows containing only {New, New Repeat}, cust-type='existing' returned 16 rows containing only {Existing}. No blank screens, no error banners (skpi-error/crm-error/sbr-error all absent).

issues: Initial unfiltered /kpi-reports/crm-summary over 800k customers takes ~15-25s; during that time the 5 KPI cards show 'N/A' and the 3 charts render empty axes with no skeleton/loading indicator — looks like a broken page. Suggest a loading state (spinner/skeleton) for the summary block.
'Overall Sales (Top 10)' X-axis tickFormatter divides by 100000, so with preview-scale data every tick renders as '₹0L' (all identical). Consider an adaptive formatter (K/L/Cr).

React DOM warning logged as console error: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' Traced to AdminLayout-level render; no visible breakage but noisy — worth locating the offending select/option markup.

action_items: Optional: add loading skeleton for CRM report summary KPI cards/charts (currently 'N/A' for up to ~25s on unfiltered load).
Optional: fix Store KPI top-stores X-axis tick formatter (all ticks show ₹0L).
Optional: resolve React '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: useColumns persists visible columns in localStorage; existing users who already have 'kazo-storekpi-cols' saved will NOT see the new 'Unmapped Value' column until they hit Reset — consider versioning the storage key when BASE_COLS changes.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing preview seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 report pages render and expose the new features. Note: Store KPI/Shopper Bill default date ranges (current month) return 0 rows in preview seed data — always widen start date to 2020-01-01 before asserting table content. Store column values in CRM crm-store select are store UUIDs; labels are 'Name (CODE)'. CRM summary is slow (~15-25s) unfiltered, so wait >=25s before asserting KPI card numbers.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional defects found this run.
